user.title: Connect STIPS account
user.description: Choose the STIPS API environment, then sign in. Production is the default. Production uses `production.api.stips.visionalization.net`; staging uses `stips.api.stagging.visionalization.net`. The login downloads your IR catalog; normal IR control runs locally on your LAN.

reconfigure.title: STIPS connection
reconfigure.description: Change the API environment for this existing STIPS entry and refresh its account catalog. Production uses `production.api.stips.visionalization.net`; staging uses `stips.api.stagging.visionalization.net`. Leave the password blank to keep the current password.

device_ip.title: Device IP
device_ip.description: Review the LAN IP for **{device_name}** (`{device_unique_name}`). The API reported **{detected_ip}**. You can edit the IP before saving it. Leave it blank to use hostname/mDNS only.

ip_options.title: Automatic IP updates
ip_options.description: When enabled, Home Assistant does not poll the IRU1. It tries the saved IP first. Only if that IP cannot be reached but the device still responds through mDNS/hostname, the integration reads `/device_info` in the background and saves the new `ip_address`.

data.auto_update_ip: Recover changed IP after mDNS fallback

reauth_confirm.title: Update STIPS credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The saved STIPS credentials are no longer accepted. Enter valid credentials for the same account. The catalog will be refreshed after successful login.

error.no_catalog_permission: Login succeeded, but this account has no permission to read IR catalog endpoints
error.no_areas: No areas found for this account
error.no_devices: No IR devices found for this account
error.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IP address or leave the field blank

abort.already_configured: This STIPS account is already configured

device_ip.title: Device IP
device_ip.description: Edit the saved LAN IP for **{device_name}** (`{device_unique_name}`). The last cloud catalog IP is **{detected_ip}**. Leave it blank to use hostname/mDNS only.

ip_options.title: Automatic IP updates
ip_options.description: When enabled, there is no periodic IP check. The integration only reads `/device_info` after the saved IP fails and the IRU1 command succeeds through mDNS/hostname, then saves the new IP for future commands.

data.auto_update_ip: Recover changed IP after mDNS fallback

error.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IP address or leave the field blank
